newsitem.title: USA: Trenton Savings to buy Manchester Trust.
newsitem.headline: Trenton Savings to buy Manchester Trust.

text.p: Trenton Savings Bank on Friday said it executed a definitive agreement to acquire Manchester Trust Bank for $12.94 a share in cash, or a total of about $4.0 million.
Under the terms, Manchester operate as a subsidiary of Trenton Savings, the company said.
The acquisition is expected to be completed in the third quarter of 1997. It is subject to approval by the regulatory authorities and by the shareholders of Manchester Trust, Trenton Savings said.
Trenton Savings has assets in excess of $625 million and operates 14 branch offices. Manchester is a trust services company that employs 10 people.
